title: Machine Learning Compiler Engineer
description: <h3>About the position</h3> <p>We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. </p> <p>Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.</p> <p>ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.</p> <p>If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3>About you</h3> <p>The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. </p> <p>Some other things you might be excited about are:</p> <ul> <li>Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning</li> <li>ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation</li> <li>GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores</li> <li>Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection</li> <li>ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching</li> <li>ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing</li> <li>GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute</li> <li>Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems</li> <li>Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming</li> <li>Fluency in English is required</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Programme Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>About WPP Production</strong></p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://wpp.com/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$" data-outlook-id="6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd">WPP.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>A Hybrid working model</strong></p> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p class="xmsonormal"><em>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</em></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.</p> <p>You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.</p> <p>Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead the programme</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.</li> <li>Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.</li> <li>Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.</li> <li>Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.</li> <li>Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.</li> <li>Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.</li> <li>Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.</li> <li>Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Align clients and stakeholders</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.</li> <li>Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.</li> <li>Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.</li> <li>Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deliver measurable outcomes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.</li> <li>Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.</li> <li>Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.</li> <li>Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.</li> <li>Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.</li> <li>The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.</li> <li>The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.</li> <li>A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.</li> </ul> <p>Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.</p> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <ul> <li>A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.</li> <li>Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.</li> <li>Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.</li> <li>Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.</li> <li>Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.</li> <li>A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-HYBRID</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-RH1</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Why work here: <br></strong><span data-teams="true">At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. </span></p> <p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Inclusion and Impact </strong><br>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. <br><strong><br></strong><strong>Data</strong><br>We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://www.hogarthww.com/privacy-policy">st</a><a href="https://www.hogarth.com/privacy-policy">atement</a>.</span> This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.<br><br></p> <div> <div> <p class="xmsonormal" style="text-align: left;"><strong>Please contact <a ----- ----- if you need the job advert or form in another format.</strong></p> </div> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Manager / Associate Director, Corporate Tax Advisory
description: <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>Join the UK’s market leading Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team and make a real difference on a range of high profile and dynamic transactions. Our Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team specialises in providing tax advice on the restructuring of financially distressed businesses. They have built a fantastic track record in recent years, leading on some of Europe’s largest and most complex restructuring processes. These include debt restructuring transactions, debt-for-equity swaps, business reconstructions via Restructuring Plans, Schemes of Arrangement and CVAs, and insolvency appointments. The variety of work really stands out, as does the friendly and supportive nature of the team. The team has a great mix of UK and international transactions work and is looking to recruit a corporation tax specialist at Associate Director level to build on the existing business capability and target a number of exciting developments in the restructuring market. This role is primarily advisory focused but will have some compliance responsibility. This is a unique opportunity to get involved. The role is technically interesting and personally rewarding.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p>Your key areas of focus will include:</p> <ul> <li>Working directly with our financial advisory colleagues and external stakeholders including lenders, borrowers and legal advisors to understand the often complex commercial and legal requirements of each restructuring transaction;</li> <li>Developing a strategy for achieving the commercial aims in a tax efficient manner.</li> <li>Reviewing and preparing reports setting out the steps necessary to meet the aims of the transaction;</li> <li>Advising insolvency practitioners involved in the restructuring on the tax consequences of their intended actions;</li> <li>Advising on the submission of appropriate tax returns or other documentation to tax authorities and liaising with them, as required;</li> <li>Supporting the business development activities of the team (you will have a broad scope to build relationships both internally and with key clients); and</li> <li>Contributing to the technical and personal development training of the broader team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <p>To qualify for the role you must have:</p> <ul> <li>ACA/CTA or equivalent qualification or experience;</li> <li>Strong UK tax technical skills;</li> <li>Strong communication, team playing and project management skills;  and</li> <li>The ability to perform strongly under pressure.</li> </ul> <p>Prior experience of transactions or insolvency processes is preferred.</p> <h2><strong>What can we offer you?</strong></h2> <p>New joiners are supported by a week-long induction programme, and continuous improvement is achieved through a structured and tailored programme that suits your career development.</p> <p>As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including:</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Salary</li> <li>28 days holiday</li> <li>Discretionary Bonus Scheme</li> <li>Cash benefits allowance</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>Extensive investment in personal development & learning</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave</li> <li>Group Income protection</li> <li>Life assurance</li> <li>Cycle to work schemes</li> <li>Regular social, cultural and charitable activities</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Teneo</strong></h2> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.</p> <p>The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 40+ offices around the world.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead UX/UI Designer
description: Lead UX/UI Designer Fixed-term contract 6 months (maternity cover) London — hybrid, with regular presence in our London office Delta Capita is a global provider of managed services, technology and consulting to the financial services industry. Design sits at the centre of how we build our products. Our team shapes the interfaces our clients and their customers use every day. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead UX/UI Designer to cover a 6-month period of maternity leave, starting November 2026 and based in our London office. You will own the design of complex, multi-stakeholder products end to end - from early problem solving through to prototypes and production-ready UI. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams on a day-to-day basis, with support from senior stakeholders as needed. You will be comfortable making confident design decisions, shipping in short cycles, and iterating once real feedback arrives.You will be responsible for leading other junior designers in the team, to make help them make decisions, give feedback and make sure work is delivered to a high standard and on time. Key responsibilities Own complex projects end to end. Take full design accountability for one or more product workstreams, from early discovery through wireframes, prototypes and final UI specification. Design and prototype. Produce interactive prototypes in Sketch to test flows, validate concepts with users and align stakeholders before build. Run and facilitate workshops. Across teams and features, driving strategic alignment. Maintain and evolve the design system. Extend our component library and design standards so that work across the team stays consistent, accessible and reusable. Support junior designers. Set direction, review work, run critique sessions and support the day-to-day development of junior members of the design team. Partner with product and engineering. Work closely with product managers to shape requirements, and with developers to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and are technically feasible. Deliver at pace. Prioritise, break large problems into shippable increments and keep momentum across parallel workstreams. Uphold accessibility and quality. Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and our internal quality bar before handover. Essential skills and experience Proven track record as a lead UX/UI designer, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex, large-scale digital products. Advanced working knowledge of Sketch, including symbols, libraries and shared styles. Strong prototyping ability - you can move from a rough concept to a testable interactive prototype quickly. Demonstrable experience mentoring or line-managing junior designers. Confident collaborating with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders and, where relevant, clients. Evidence of delivering high-quality work at pace in an agile environment. Excellent communication skills - you can explain and defend design decisions to non-designers. Right to work in the UK (we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this fixed-term role). Nice to have Previous experience designing for fintech, banking or another regulated financial services environment. Familiarity with Sketch Exposure to enterprise or B2B products with dense interfaces and complex workflows. Experience running user research and usability testing directly. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please inform us. This is a 6 months fixed term position based in London. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. Who We Are: Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services. title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description: 💰 Up to £95k depending on experience 📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours. Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide. Close, audit, tax and payments operations are already covered by the finance team. What has not been built yet is planning. This role exists to make planning a discipline the leadership team uses every week: a forecast budget owners trust, and unit economics that change decisions. 🎯 The Role We're hiring a Senior FP&A Analyst/Senior Commercial Analyst to build and own Fanvue's company model, forecasting and commercial analysis, reporting to our VP Finance. This is hands-on. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Director, </span></strong><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">International Tax </span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><br></span></strong>We are looking for an <strong>Director, </strong><strong>International Tax</strong> to build and own the international tax function at Quince. Permanent establishment. VAT and GST registration. Withholding tax. Transfer pricing. Customs and import duty treatment. description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🎯 The Role We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer - Agentic to join our Agentic Service. title: Risk Analyst
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. We’re looking for a Risk Analyst You'll support & refine our lending strategy within Germany, including supporting new growth initiatives, designing & analysing tests, supporting the development of our scorecards and underwriting strategy, and managing our portfolio risk. Working closely with data scientists, credit analysts and cross functional teams, you’ll solve analytical problems to help us provide small & medium size businesses in Germany with the funds they need to grow. The team The Lending Strategy team decides who iwoca lends to in Germany, and on what terms. Its work covers model development, lending strategy, and portfolio risk. The team works closely with Data Science (credit models), Product, tech teams, Operations Strategy, and our team of Credit Analysts. The team’s work is central to iwoca Germany’s growth and has a direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. The team includes data scientists, developers, and risk analysts, all working hybrid schedules in London. The role We're looking for a curious and motivated individual to join our Lending Strategy team as a Risk Analyst. You’ll work with analysts, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to shape iwoca Germany’s lending strategy. Key responsibilities include: Build expertise in the credit domain. Develop your analytical skills through exposure to different experimental approaches and complex analysis. Play a leading role in providing insightful analytics on the risk profile of our lending book and assisting with lending strategy decisions. Partner with key stakeholders within Team Germany in order to provide credit risk expertise to multi-disciplinary projects. Work closely with the data science teams to improve our credit assessment scorecards & strategies (both for our automated and manual underwriting processes). We believe close collaboration within a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use. Our app runs 24/7 in care facilities, delivering real-time alerts and monitoring residents. This isn't a typical app dev role. title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice)
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation.  We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.  </p> <p><em>For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit <a href="https://www.crai.com">our website.</a></em></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, assisting Vice Presidents and other senior staff by providing conceptual and practical input to competition case work as required. The role brings with it the possibility of working on some of the largest and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in the shaping of the cases.</p> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>First degree in economics and a PhD/DPhil in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialism with large data sets (empirical PhDs) or Industrial Organisation and/or statistics/econometrics), plus up to 3 years of relevant work experience. <ul> <li>Non-PhD applicants should have strong academic achievement in a Master's program, plus 5-7 years' relevant work experience;</li> </ul> </li> <li>Professional work experience in consulting, business, or with a competition authority strongly preferred;</li> <li>Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities, competition policy and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;</li> <li>Exceptional written and oral communication skills;</li> <li>Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;</li> <li>Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;</li> <li>Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills.</li> </ul> <h4>To Apply</h4> <p>Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curriculum Vitae</strong> – please include current address, email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Covering letter</strong> – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in London and how this role matches your goals;</li> <li><strong>Writing Sample (optional)</strong> – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;</li> <li><strong>Transcripts (optional) </strong>- from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Responsible AI Use in Recruiting</strong></p> <p>We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. title: Founding Design Engineer | CodeSpeak
description: Role : Founding Design Engineer (Senior / Staff) Company : CodeSpeak Location : London, on-site. Ideally you already live in London. Candidates based elsewhere are welcome to apply, and remote is possible for a very strong candidate, but UK-based candidates come first. Candidates with a Global Talent visa, granted or in process, are a good fit. Job Type : Full-time About CodeSpeak Agents write more code every month. Human brains stay the same. CodeSpeak is building a program model that sits one level above code, so people can see how a program works and changes over time without reading much of it. The goal is to give control back to the developer: you think about architecture, and the routine goes away. CodeSpeak was founded by Andrey Breslav, the creator of Kotlin, which millions of developers use daily. Around him is a team that has built the tools other engineers rely on, at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph, and Elastic. When it comes to program analysis and developer tooling, these are some of the best people in the world. CodeSpeak is backed by Accel and by funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, and funding covers several years. Here is the open problem. The team has a fair idea of what the program model should look like. It does not yet know how to visualise it. As Founding Design Engineer you will decide how it looks, then build it and ship it. The core engineering team has just been hired, and nobody on it has design-engineering skills. You are the missing piece. CodeSpeak is a UK company. It has no business in Russia and no ties to Russian companies. It is still testing which problems it can solve best, so priorities may shift. What you are expected to do: Design and delivery Own how people interact with CodeSpeak: in the CLI, on the web and on any future platform. Design the interfaces yourself. Build many prototypes, decide on the right UX and ship the result. Harden the prototypes users liked, so they hold up on real data, with the same care for performance and product quality as for design. Ship features to production without help from the rest of the team. Product problems CodeSpeak works with unusually complex information: developer intent, requirements, code, architecture, the relationships between them, how they change over time, contradictions and dependencies. The job is not to display it, but to help developers understand it, navigate it and act on it. Find a way to visualise CodeSpeak's new, higher-level program model. In your first 30 days, visualise the architecture of a codebase split into components. Go deeper from there: a single component, its diff and its code review. Then interfaces that let developers navigate structured requirements and how they relate to each other, review requirements alongside code review, see how requirements map onto parts of the codebase, explore how intent, architecture and code change over time, browse agent sessions, find contradictions between requirements, and edit and reorganise requirements rather than only view them. Web UI is the simplest and most obvious platform. Some of this will live in the console. VS Code plugins and other desktop frameworks may follow, and the final scope is still open. Ways of working Find tasks and clarify requirements without waiting for a brief. Nobody will micromanage you. Egor and Andrey give general direction. Work directly with the founder and the engineering team to turn early ideas and hypotheses into intuitive, interactive product experiences. Take part in design meetings, where many decisions are made on the spot. Explain and defend your design decisions to Egor and Andrey. Both hold strong opinions, and both argue hard. Argue for your tasks, and step back with good grace if the team disagrees. What you need to succeed: Craft You can design an interface, prototype it and ship it to production on your own. You have strong design taste, and your portfolio shows it: UX, interaction design, information architecture and visual hierarchy. For this role the portfolio is critical. You make complex information or a complex data model easy to read. Think maps with metadata or dense dashboards, with non-trivial state. Tools that read and write count for more than infographics or landing pages. You have solid computer science and software engineering fundamentals, plus TypeScript, and deep experience building production apps with modern UI frameworks such as React. At least 3 years of delivering production software. You understand the problems of engineers, because engineers are CodeSpeak's users. How you work You can say why you made each design choice. "I'm an artist, I see it this way" will not work here. You are curious and self-directed, and you care about making programming better. You gather requirements and find projects yourself. You actively improve your own workflow with AI-powered coding tools. You work hard and can be reached when a task needs it. The team has no weekend-work culture. You think fast and explain your reasoning clearly. You speak Russian, which is the team's working language. This is a priority, not a hard rule, and a strong candidate without Russian will still be considered. Nice to have A background as a frontend engineer with good taste. Engineers from SwiftUI, desktop, mobile or full-stack are welcome if they visualise complex things very well. Experience with complex data visualisation. Some sense of what an early-stage startup is like. A big-tech engineer who knows what they are joining can fit, and so can a former co-founder. A technical degree is not required. Self-taught people and people with degrees in geology or biology have done well in roles like this. What you get: An unsolved problem with real room for your taste. The team is inventing a new way to represent programs, and you decide how it looks. A boutique team of strong engineers, built carefully, who have built developer tools at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph and Elastic. An ML team of four, led by Emeli Dral. She co-founded Evidently, an evals startup, and co-authored a very popular Coursera course for data scientists. Day-to-day work with Egor, Andrey and the tech lead. Backing from Accel and from funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, with funding for several years. A UK contract with a pension and medical insurance. Autonomy. You set your own tasks and nobody hovers over you. Work in AI, a field most people want to be in. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution. As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery. Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate. While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US. As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will: Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role. Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on. Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders. Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation. Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure. Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing. Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours. Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge. Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers. Independence : Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes. High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans. Monitoring : A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics. Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies). Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts. Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption. Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change. Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking. PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS). OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments. Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation. Growth & Innovation: Openness to learn the required technologies. An interest in development, new technologies and innovation. Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt. At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team! title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience. You should apply if these excite you: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy. High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation. You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won't be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best. Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies. In this role, you will: Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving. Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar. Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence. Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience. Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet. A small team that ships fast . What you’ll do Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying Engineer how we feed context to AI models : how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention Evolve our workflow builder : something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections Design the architecture behind the product : how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t. You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states. You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API. Interview process An initial call with our talent team. title: Field and ABM Manager, Europe
description: As a Field and ABM Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just running events; you are the person who makes vCluster Labs the name Europe’s AI cloud builders know. Europe is where sovereign AI is being built, from regional AI clouds and telcos launching GPU services to governments that need data to stay local. You’ll own account-based and field marketing for every target AI cloud and enterprise account in Europe, and you’ll support Middle East and APAC accounts until those regions have dedicated coverage. The 2027 plan, the account list and strong product marketing, DevRel and ecosystem teams are already in place. You’ll be one of the first hires on the growth team that brings it to life. As a Field and ABM Manager, your role will include: Account-Based Marketing: You will run ABM by tier. For our highest-priority European accounts, you’ll build 1:1 plans with AEs that include an executive sponsor, a custom business case, personalized pages, direct mail and invite-only dinners. For the next tier, such as sovereign EU clouds, NVIDIA Cloud Partners and telcos, you’ll run 1:few campaigns and adapt each quarterly campaign kit to European languages, regulations and buying processes. The Sovereign AI Cloud Story: You will own the regional program for our Q3 sovereign AI campaign, built around RAISE Summit Paris. You’ll run roundtables and briefings on data residency and tenant isolation at the infrastructure layer for the buyers who care most about them. Field Marketing & Events: You will plan and run executive dinners, roadshows, workshops and co-hosted events with NVIDIA, OEMs and ecosystem partners. You’ll turn KubeCon Europe, MWC Barcelona and ISC Hamburg into Tier 1 meetings and VIP dinners, and you’ll measure every program by how it moves accounts forward. Buying Groups & Thought Leadership: You will reach the economic buyer, technical decision maker, champion, product owner and gatekeeper in every account, each with a message built for their role and market. You’ll put our executives, engineers and customers in front of European buyers through panels, roundtables and local media. You’ll also work with Content and Product Marketing to adapt assets for European audiences. Sales Partnership & Measurement: You will agree on target accounts with European AEs and SDRs every quarter. Every touch gets a named follow-up owner and an SLA, and every high-intent event signal reaches an AE within two business days. You’ll track account progression weekly and program ROI quarterly, then scale what works and stop what doesn’t. Early Impact: In your first 30 days, you’ll lock Tier 1 account plans with Sales and map the European field calendar for the first half of 2027. Within two quarters, every Tier 1 account in Europe will have an engaged buying group of 3+ roles and your field events will hold a 50%+ show rate. By the end of 2027, RAISE Paris and the sovereign campaign will have produced named Tier 1 and Tier 2 meetings and opportunities. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: ABM & Field Experience: 7+ years in B2B field marketing, ABM or demand generation across European markets, including at least 3 years running ABM against a named account list. You’ve run field programs that sourced or advanced pipeline in complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders. Technical Buyer Fluency: Experience marketing to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, HPC, data centers, telco or developer platforms. European Market Depth: You know how European buyers evaluate vendors, including GDPR, data residency and sovereign cloud requirements. Executive Presence: Comfort hosting senior executives and running events across several countries. GTM Tooling: Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot and ABM or intent tools such as 6sense, Demandbase or Clay. Builder’s Mentality: A bias for action and the ability to build programs from scratch on an early-stage team. You’re fluent in English, have the right to work in Europe and are open to travel up to 40%. Bonus points for: Languages: German or French. Regional Network: Existing relationships with sovereign AI clouds, regional cloud providers or telcos in Europe. Partner Co-Marketing: Experience co-marketing with NVIDIA, OEMs or European cloud and data center partners. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Benefits We offer the following benefits: Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. Culture & Values At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for: Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About the Role At Cenosco , we build Asset Integrity Management Software trusted by global leaders in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Energy and beyond. We are building a new data platform from the ground up, and we need a Senior Data Engineer to shape it: the architecture, the tooling, and the single source of truth our products and teams will rely on. You will join the Data Engineering team, make real architectural decisions, and bring a pioneering mindset. No tools are set in stone, so we expect you to propose what works best and back it with reasoning. What You'll Do Platform & Architecture Design and build our data platform from scratch, from ingestion to modelling to consumption Take part in architectural decisions and help choose the right technologies (Snowflake, Databricks, or something you propose) Research, evaluate, and implement a single source of truth across our data landscape Data Integration Connect and consolidate data from multiple IMS databases and other heterogeneous sources Design and build reliable, scalable ELT/ETL pipelines Develop data models that serve both product and analytical needs Collaboration Work closely with Product, Engineering, Domain Expertise, and other departments to turn business needs into solid data solutions Raise the quality bar through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing Help shape engineering practices and standards as the team grows What You'll Need 8+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering Professional experience in a SaaS or Data-as-a-Service environment Solid SQL and Python Hands-on experience designing and building ELT/ETL pipelines Strong data modelling skills (dimensional and/or lakehouse) Production experience with at least one modern cloud data platform (Snowflake or Databricks ideal; BigQuery or Synapse also welcome) Experience integrating data from multiple heterogeneous sources Experience owning or influencing architectural and tooling decisions, and the ability to explain the trade-offs Comfortable building without an existing backlog, structure, or playbook Fluent English and strong communication skills Bonus Points For Experience with orchestration and transformation tools (Airflow, dbt, Dagster) Infrastructure as code and CI/CD (Terraform, Git-based workflows) Experience with data governance, data quality, or master data management Experience with Azure (or another major cloud) Working Location UK - Remote Why You'll Love Working with Us Build a data platform from scratch, with real influence on direction and tooling Work on software used in safety-critical industries - your work genuinely matters Freedom to propose and pioneer rather than inherit someone else's decisions Join a small, engaged team where your voice carries weight Flexible working arrangements that fit both you and the role Competitive compensation with meaningful additional perks and top-notch equipment Real investment in your growth - continuous learning is part of how we work Team activities chosen by the team, not the marketing department Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Sales Development Representative
description: Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️ We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻 📝 Overview The Sales Development Representative is responsible for qualifying and routing inbound leads across two channels: self-service and inside sales. This role involves frequent engagement with prospects through phone calls, emails, live chat, and internal tools such as Slack and Salesforce. This role runs inside that same AI-native approach we build for customers. Leads and account data flow into an AI-populated Salesforce, so reps start from a clean, enriched pipeline instead of manual entry. Every call is coached live by ClaudeMate, giving real-time feedback on framing, objection handling, and next steps as the conversation happens. Success in the role is measured by the number of product demonstrations booked and completed, with a strong track record of team performance consistently meeting or exceeding monthly targets. Room to grow, fast-tracked We hire SDRs expecting you to grow past the role. “Grow from Within" is one of our leadership operating principles - meaning proven performance gets noticed and backed fast, and that managers and leaders are encouraged to gravitate towards internal promotions vs. external hires For SDRs, that typically means a path to Account Executive within 9 to 12 months, based on performance, not tenure. One of our SDRs moved into a leadership role running Sales Development for all of North America within 8 months. Others have made the jump from SDR to Enterprise AE and describe the same pattern from the other side: "Sitemate is process-driven (everything engineered), so if you can learn and grow from these processes and you’re open to honest, constructive feedback while giving your best every day, you'll level up quickly". Read more stories like these on People of Sitemate . Employment: Salary: OTE Remuneration: £49,500 (incl. Pension) Base Salary: £33,000 Commission: £16,500 🔧 Day-to-Day You will be qualifying and routing inbound leads through two channels; self service & inside sales You’ll be spending most of your time with prospects across phone calls, emails and live chat on our website, as well as internal tools like slack and salesforce. Your quota is measured by the number of demonstrations booked and completed at the subsequent stage of the process. Our current team in this role have achieved >=95% of their targets each month since starting ⚡ Challenges Learning about the built world if you haven’t had any exposure to it - there are a lot of different types of companies and plenty of new terminologies to learn. Up-skilling your call/phone and email skills - although we have plenty of examples for you to learn from during your onboarding. Understanding SaaS financial acronyms and common terminology - if you have not worked in a SaaS company before, there is going to be a lot of metrics to learn. This cheat sheet is a good resource: The Ultimate SaaS Acronyms Cheat Sheet We move very quickly, so you’ll need to be excited to come in and learn extremely fast. ✅ Who This Role is For Ambitious individuals wanting to pursue a career in SaaS People who thrive in a structured, high-agency, KPI-driven environment Strong communicators who enjoy building relationships Resilient individuals who can persevere and perform with high-volume tasks 🚫 Who This Role is Not For Those unwilling to handle rejection frequently People uncomfortable with people and conversations 🎯 Skills & Tools Must Have: Confident and clear communication skills, with excellent writing and presentation skills over email, phone, video conferencing and in-person. Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently. Nice to Have: Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases. Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers). Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy. About Sitemate: Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world. Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records. With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture. Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site. We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada. Life at Sitemate At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day. We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure. We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51. Our Core Values Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate. Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change High Vis : A high visibility, transparent and open environment Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself Learn more about our values: Read: On Sitemate's Values, Culture and DNA Listen: Unleashing your Zilla On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture What We Offer Competitive, performance-based remuneration Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build 25 days paid annual leave , plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support) Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources Laptop and home office setup budget Flexible work - a hybrid rhythm, with 2 to 3 days in office, 2 WFH each week - with the flexibility to work from anywhere for several weeks a year Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions London office perks - large private outdoor terrace, on-site showers & bike storage, surrounded by cafés, galleries & vibrant nightlife in the heart of Shoreditch and a 5-minute walk to Old Street tube Equal Opportunity We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Learn More About Sitemate 🎧 Podcasts 2026: CRO Lance Hodgson - on why the built world is jumping straight to AI and what that changes 2024: CEO Hartley Pike - on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture 2022: CTO Tim Bray - on building quality features that solve real customer problems 💬 Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team : People of Sitemate ⭐ Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd , Trust Radius 🎥 Team Offsites: 2022 , 2023 , 2024, 2025 PLEASE Note: We hire directly and don’t work with agencies Compensation: £49.5K • Offers Equity • £16.5K Commission • Base Salary: £33,000 & Commission: £16,500 (incl. title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer. We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards. You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include: Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise. Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk. Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail. Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work. We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community. You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and experimental teams across the company. About You You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed. You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You understand modern machine learning and can write the code, run the experiments, and analyse the results needed to test your ideas. You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work. You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim. You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them. You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project.
